run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T13:15:40Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert fires because the frontend's `/api/data` path fails on its AdService dependency: the ad Deployment (otel-demo/ad) has had no running pod since 13:14:38, so every GetAds call fails. The ad pod was deliberately scaled 1→0 at 13:14:38 and the Deployment was scaled back 0→1 ten seconds later, but the replacement pod `ad-554b849958-v9dqt` was refused by the API server: `exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m` (≈1433.6Mi hard vs 1901Mi used). The 1901Mi used equals exactly the sum of memory requests of the 20 running otel-demo pods, i.e. the namespace is already over its quota before ad is added, so the ad pod cannot be recreated. The ad Service has no endpoints, ad emits no spans after ~13:15, and the frontend's error spans begin in the 5-minute bucket ending 13:15:43 — immediately after the pod deletion — confined to GET, `/api/data`, `grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` and `tcp.connect`, with zero error spans on its cart/checkout/recommendation/product paths. frontend-proxy shows its own ingress/egress error spans in the same window. The remaining unknowns are who/what triggered the scale-down and why the quota hard limit is below existing usage; change history is not integrated here.

claims.text: In 13:15:43–13:31:43 the frontend service recorded error spans only on these operations: GET 484.53 spans, executing api route (pages) /api/data 484.53, GET /api/data 484.53, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 484.53 and tcp.connect 10.74; its CartService GetCart/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, GET/POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout series all returned 0 error spans in the same window.

Frontend had zero error spans in the 60 minutes ending 13:14:00, and sampled frontend traces from 12:50–13:13:56 show only HTTP 200 / rpc.grpc.status_code 0 spans on cart and product routes (Jaeger data for frontend ends at 13:13:56).

Frontend error spans first appear in the 5-minute bucket ending 13:15:43 (35.56), then 316.67 and 197.99 in the following buckets, all on GET, GET /api/data, executing api route /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (plus 7.78/6.67/4.77 on tcp.connect); the errors were still non-zero in the last bucket.
The ad service stopped producing spans: total ad span rate was 2.25, 2.03, 2.40 and 2.21 per second for the buckets covering 12:45–13:15 and exactly 0 for the buckets ending 13:20:43 and 13:25:43.

Deployment otel-demo/ad has spec.replicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1 and a ReplicaFailure condition at 13:14:48 (lastUpdateTime) with reason FailedCreate: 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m', and its Available condition is False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable).

Only one ad ReplicaSet exists (ad-554b849958, owner Deployment ad, spec.replicas 1, readyReplicas absent, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad), no pod with an ad-* name exists in otel-demo, and the 20 running pods contain none belonging to ad, while the deployments table shows ad with no replicas/available/ready values and every other workload at 1/1/1.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo show ScalingReplicaSet on ad scaling ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0 at 13:14:38 (with Killing/'Stopping container ad' and SuccessfulDelete of pod ad-554b849958-p226w), ScalingReplicaSet from 0 to 1 at 13:14:48, then ten FailedCreate warnings at 13:14:48–13:14:49 and one 'combined from similar events' FailedCreate at 13:20:16, all with the same memory-quota message; no Evicted or OOMKilled event appears in the namespace.
ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory has hard memory 1503238553600m (≈1433.6Mi) and status used memory 1901Mi.

The memory requests of the 20 running otel-demo pods sum to exactly 1901Mi, matching the quota's used value; the flagd pod carries two containers (flagd 120Mi and flagd-ui 250Mi = 370Mi), and the largest single requests are kafka 300Mi, load-generator 100Mi, otel-collector 150Mi, fraud-detection 200Mi and accounting 160Mi.
Service otel-demo/ad exists with selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad and targetPort 8080, but the corresponding Endpoints object 'ad' in otel-demo has subsets null, i.e. no backend addresses.

frontend-proxy recorded its own error spans in 13:15:43–13:31:43 on ingress (497.42 spans) and router frontend egress (493.13 spans), against only 4.16 frontend-proxy error spans in the whole preceding 60 minutes.
The frontend workload itself is up: deployment frontend is 1 replica/1 available/1 ready and pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is Running, ready, with 0 restarts, started 12:44:13.

The ad deployment template is ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with cpu 10m / memory 225Mi requests, strategy RollingUpdate and metadata.generation 3, and the running flagd pod's flagd-ui container reports a memory request of 250Mi while its owning ReplicaSet (and the flagd deployment template) declares no memory request for flagd-ui.

Metric discovery in this Prometheus returns 58 metric names (traces_span_metrics_calls_total, traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket plus container/node/process/go/jvm/redis/v8js infrastructure metrics) and no kube_* series at all; a query for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned no metric names.

Before it disappeared the ad application was not recording failed GetAds calls: over the 76-minute window ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server span counted 1137.69 STATUS_CODE_UNSET and 0 error spans, and ad's only error spans were flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 1.02 — so the failure mode is ad absence, not ad-reported handler errors.

Nonzero error spans are not new for other services: in the 60 minutes before 13:14:00 recommendation already had 2.08 and fraud-detection 1.05 error spans, and in the incident window they show only 1.07 each (about one span), so their errors are background and are not evidence that they were newly broken.

Primary cause: ad has been unavailable since 13:14:38 because its only pod was scaled away and its replacement is blocked by the otel-demo-memory quota (used 1901Mi > hard ≈1433.6Mi, with the new pod needing a further 225Mi); the frontend /api/data path depends on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, so those requests fail (with tcp.connect errors showing the connection-level failure) and frontend's error rate rises, which is what the RequestErrorRate alert reports.

The quota was already smaller than the namespace's real demand before ad was deleted: 20 pods born at 12:44–12:46 request 1901Mi in total, so the 1433.6Mi hard limit either was created/lowered after those pods existed or effective requests grew (the flagd-ui container's 250Mi request exists on the pod but not in its ReplicaSet template, e.g. via defaulting). Which of the two happened cannot be determined here because change history is not integrated and LimitRange objects are not queryable in this Run.

The 13:14:38 scale-down of ad to 0 and the 13:14:48 scale-up back to 1 were external scale actions rather than an application crash or a template rollout: the events are ScalingReplicaSet 1→0 with a graceful container stop, only one ad ReplicaSet exists with the unchanged 2.1.3-ad image, and there is no BackOff, Unhealthy, Evicted or OOMKilled event; the actor that issued the scale cannot be identified from the available sources.

Give the namespace enough quota to admit the ad pod: set otel-demo-memory hard memory to at least the current 1901Mi plus ad's 225Mi (≈2126Mi) with headroom, or reduce per-pod memory requests; the ad ReplicaSet will then create its pod and the frontend /api/data failures should clear.

Verify through change history (an integration not available in this Run) who scaled deployment ad to 0 at 13:14:38 and whether otel-demo-memory's hard limit or a LimitRange default was changed, and align the quota with the namespace's effective memory requests so future pod recreations are not blocked.

gaps: Change history is not integrated, so who/what scaled otel-demo/ad from 1 to 0 at 13:14:38 and back to 1 at 13:14:48, and whether the otel-demo-memory hard limit was lowered/created after the workloads, cannot be verified.

Jaeger holds no frontend traces after 13:13:56 (data_as_of of the last successful search), and a search for frontend error=true spans in 12:45:40–13:31:43 returned no traces, so post-incident error span tags/details (e.g. the exact gRPC status of grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds or the HTTP status of the frontend-proxy error spans) could not be read.
The ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its logs, last termination reason and exit code are unreadable; no Evicted or OOMKilled marker for it exists in the namespace events.
Frontend container logs returned 0 lines (empty current stream, no previous instance), so there is no application-log corroboration of the GetAds failure.

Prometheus in this target has no kube-state-metrics series (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready, kube_pod_owner, kube_replicaset_owner) and no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count or app_payment_transactions_total series in the window; those queries returned no data, so replica availability and the alert rule's exact source could not be confirmed from metrics.

No alerting rules are loaded in this Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules with type=alert returned none; rule_name RequestErrorRate returned none), so the expression behind the alert's 'current: 5.088888888888889' value could not be reproduced or verified.

limitranges are not a queryable resource kind in this Run, so the mechanism behind the flagd-ui container's 250Mi memory request on the pod (present in neither its ReplicaSet template nor the flagd deployment template) is unconfirmed.

For services other than frontend, frontend-proxy, ad, recommendation, fraud-detection, payment and accounting, no error-span series were returned at all in 13:15:43–13:31:43, which is unknown rather than a confirmed zero; cart, checkout, product-catalog, currency, email, image-provider, quote, shipping, kafka and load-generator were not individually examined for errors.
next_steps: Confirm with the platform owner whether the otel-demo-memory ResourceQuota (hard memory 1503238553600m) or a LimitRange default was recently changed, and whether the ad Deployment scale-down at 13:14:38 was an intentional operation.

After quota is corrected, verify that an ad pod is created, that the ad Endpoints object gains addresses, and that frontend's GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans return to zero.
Obtain frontend/ad application logs or a Jaeger capture from after 13:14 to confirm the exact gRPC status and client-side error message of the failing GetAds calls.
